import PV_L2C_VecRead
import PV_L2C_ReferenceQ
import PV_L2C_QFold
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_ExtractedRows
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProverBalance9
open PV_L2C_NativeQ PV_L2C_ReferenceQ PV_L2C_QFold PV_L2C_QBalance
open R1Z.ProverCommitFoldSteps R1Z.ProverCommitBalanceRecursion

def lookup (table : Fin 1024 → Q) (r : Usize) : Q :=
  if h : r.val<1024 then table ⟨r.val,h⟩ else zero

def flag (active : Fin 1024 → Bool) (r : Usize) : Bool :=
  if h : r.val<1024 then active ⟨r.val,h⟩ else true

def selected (table : Fin 1024 → Q) (active : Fin 1024 → Bool)
    (d : Usize) (rows : List Usize) : List Q :=
  rows.filterMap (fun r => if (!flag active r) && (r != d) then some (lookup table r) else none)

theorem read_step (table : Fin 1024 → Q) (active : Fin 1024 → Bool)
    (d r : Usize) (hr : r.val<1024) (s : Q) :
    qm31ReadStep (alloc.vec.Vec.deref (PV_L2C_VecRead.vector PV_L2C_VecRead.bound1024
      (fun i => source (table i)))) d (PV_L2C_VecRead.active active) r (source s)=
      (if (!flag active r) && (r != d) then ok (source (addQ s (lookup table r))) else ok (source s)) := by
  unfold qm31ReadStep
  rw [PV_L2C_VecRead.read _ _ _ hr]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  have hr' : r.val<(1024#usize).val := by scalar_tac
  rw [PV_L2C_VecRead.read_active (n:=1024#usize) active r hr']
  simp only [bind_tc_ok, qm31_row, flag,lookup,dif_pos hr]
  split <;> simp only [add_source]
#print axioms read_step

theorem fold_source (table : Fin 1024 → Q) (active : Fin 1024 → Bool)
    (d : Usize) (rows : List Usize) (hb : ∀ r∈rows,r.val<1024) (s : Q) :
    foldSteps (qm31ReadStep (alloc.vec.Vec.deref
      (PV_L2C_VecRead.vector PV_L2C_VecRead.bound1024 (fun i => source (table i))))
      d (PV_L2C_VecRead.active active)) rows (source s)=
        ok (source (foldQ (selected table active d rows) s)) := by
  induction rows generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons r rows ih =>
    have hr := hb r (by simp)
    have ht : ∀ x∈rows,x.val<1024 := fun x hx => hb x (by simp [hx])
    simp only [foldSteps,read_step table active d r hr,selected,List.filterMap_cons]
    split <;> simp only [bind_tc_ok,Option.toList_some,Option.toList_none,List.cons_append,
      List.nil_append,foldQ] <;> exact ih ht _
#print axioms fold_source

#print core.slice.index.Usize.index_mut
#print alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut
#print Slice.index_mut_usize
#print Slice.set
end PV_L2C_ExtractedRows

import PV_L2C_VecRead
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_VecWrite
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result PV_L2C_VecRead

theorem index_mut {A : Type} {n : Nat} (hn : n≤Usize.max) (f : Fin n → A)
    (r : Usize) (hr : r.val<n) :
    alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice A) (vector hn f) r=
      ok (f ⟨r.val,hr⟩, Slice.set (alloc.vec.Vec.deref (vector hn f)) r) := by
  change (do let x ← Slice.index_usize (alloc.vec.Vec.deref (vector hn f)) r
             ok (x,Slice.set (alloc.vec.Vec.deref (vector hn f)) r))=_
  rw [read hn f r hr]
  rfl
#print axioms index_mut

theorem write {A : Type} {n : Nat} (hn : n≤Usize.max) (f : Fin n → A)
    (r : Usize) (hr : r.val<n) (x : A) :
    Slice.set (alloc.vec.Vec.deref (vector hn f)) r x=
      vector hn (fun i => if i.val=r.val then x else f i) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [Slice.set_val_eq,alloc.vec.Vec.deref,vector]
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp
  · intro i hi hj
    by_cases h : i=r.val <;> simp [List.getElem_set,h]
#print axioms write
end PV_L2C_VecWrite

import PV_L2C_ExtractedRows
import PV_L2C_VecWrite
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_OwnedBalance
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProverBalance9
open PV_L2C_NativeQ PV_L2C_QBalance PV_L2C_ReferenceQ PV_L2C_ExtractedRows PV_L2C_VecRead
open R1Z.ProverCommitBalanceRecursion

def rows : List Usize := rowSequence 1024 0#usize

theorem rows_bounded : ∀ r∈rows,r.val<1024 := by
  intro r hr
  have hm : r.val∈rows.map (fun r => r.val) := List.mem_map.mpr ⟨r,hr,rfl⟩
  rw [rows,sequence_ascending 1024 0#usize (by decide)] at hm
  have hb := List.mem_range'.mp hm
  have hz : (0#usize).val=0 := by scalar_tac
  rw [hz] at hb
  omega
#print axioms rows_bounded

def output (table : Fin 1024 → Q) (active : Fin 1024 → Bool) (d : Usize) : Fin 1024 → Q :=
  fun i => if i.val=d.val then subQ zero (foldQ (selected table active d rows) zero) else table i

theorem complete_result (table : Fin 1024 → Q) (active : Fin 1024 → Bool)
    (d : Usize) (hd : d.val<1024) (ha : active ⟨d.val,hd⟩=false) :
    prover_commit_reference.balance_qm31_owned
      (vector bound1024 (fun i => source (table i))) d (PV_L2C_VecRead.active active)=
      ok (.Ok (),vector bound1024 (fun i => source (output table active d i))) := by
  have hlen : alloc.vec.Vec.len (vector bound1024 (fun i => source (table i)))=1024#usize := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    simp [alloc.vec.Vec.len,vector]
  have hd' : d.val<(1024#usize).val := by scalar_tac
  rw [qm31_owned_fold,hlen]
  simp only [bne_self_eq_false,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false]
  rw [read_active active d hd']
  simp only [ha,bind_tc_ok,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false]
  rw [← source_zero,fold_source table active d rows rows_bounded zero]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,sub_source]
  rw [PV_L2C_VecWrite.index_mut bound1024 _ d hd]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [PV_L2C_VecWrite.write bound1024 _ d hd]
  congr 2
  funext i
  unfold output
  split <;> rfl
#print axioms complete_result
end PV_L2C_OwnedBalance

import PV_L2C_OwnedBalance
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_RowEnumeration
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result PV_L2C_VecRead
open R1Z.ProverCommitBalanceRecursion PV_L2C_OwnedBalance

def index (i : Fin 1024) : Usize := Usize.ofNatCore i.val (by have := i.isLt; have := bound1024; omega)

theorem index_val (i : Fin 1024) : (index i).val=i.val := by rfl
#print axioms index_val

/-- Symbolic range equality, without normalizing the 1024-cell recurrence. -/
theorem enumeration : rows=List.ofFn index := by
  apply (List.map_injective (fun a b h => UScalar.eq_of_val_eq h)).mp
  rw [rows,sequence_ascending 1024 0#usize (by decide),List.map_ofFn]
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp only [List.length_range',List.length_ofFn]
  · intro i hi hj
    simp only [List.getElem_range',List.getElem_ofFn,Function.comp_apply,index_val]
    rfl
#print axioms enumeration
end PV_L2C_RowEnumeration
